tasks.short: Estimate transportation project costs from quantities

steps.what: Accept the price table for this project
List quantities against item codes
Extend each quantity by the accepted rate
Send quotes where the price table is blank
Check a quote total against quantity times rate

loop.output: lines where the total equals quantity times rate
loop.check: The item code exists and the extended total equals the quantity times the quoted rate
loop.stop: One pass, then leave a blank-rate line unmatched for the engineer
loop.why_not_simpler: Quote wording is free text and a fixed column map misses the rate

steps.what: Sign the transportation cost estimate
File the signed cost estimate

tasks.design: The bill of quantities and the price table live on a {SPREADSHEET}. Each line is the quantity times the accepted rate. A contractor quote is used only where the table is blank, and the line total must match. The transportation engineer signs the estimate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rates were typed from old estimates, so a line could not show which price-table row it used.
tasks.enabler_now: Item codes can join a quantity to one rate, and a blank rate can be held for a quote instead of a guessed number.
tasks.still_hard: A missing item code, or a quote that does not match the quantity, still needs the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer accepts the price table and signs the estimate. A quote is not a rate until the line total matches.

ambition.what: Reissue the estimate when a quantity changes, not only at the funding gate

tasks.altitude: Extension arithmetic leaves the week. The engineer still accepts the price table and signs every issue.

reach.task: Hold the signed estimate against the project budget
reach.learn: Which item codes used the price table and which used a checked quote

evidence.claim: A transport cost estimate in a mid-size firm is quantities times a price table. The judgement is which table applies, not the multiplication.
Digest [S20] says a research paper was withdrawn because the institution did not trust the data, so an extended price is filed only when it traces to a quantity and a rate.

assumptions: Focal role is the transportation engineer. The task ends when the signed cost estimate is filed. Funding approval by others is later.

Input contract: item id, quantity, unit, price-table id, rate, quote id. Producer of quantities is the bill. Producer of rates is the accepted price table. A line with no quantity is excluded. A quote is read only to fill a blank rate, then the line total must equal quantity times that rate.
Use the spreadsheet's own formulas before custom code. The price-table acceptance is a human decision.
The hours prior is spreadsheets and documents. These steps follow that and do not add a pricing meeting.
unknowns: Which price table the authority requires this year.
Whether the contractor's quote is binding.
Who may accept a price table when the engineer is away.
research_questions: What share of estimate lines have no item code?
How often does a quote fail the quantity-times-rate check?

already_counted.description: Price-table acceptance stays with the engineer
Engineer reviews quote lines that fail the total
Signature time stays on the estimate

incremental.description: Add item codes when the price table gains a new work type
Contractor resends a quote whose total did not match

approvals.approved_version: price table accepted for this project id
cost estimate signed for this project id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes quantities are free text, so the engineer still types lines and only the blank-rate check is new. The high case assumes codes exist, while accepting the table, checking quotes and signing stay. The later funding decision is not counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design drainage and erosion control for the project

steps.what: Record catchment area, soil and outfall
Choose the drainage control in the meeting
Size the erosion control on the sheet
Draft the specification from the sized fields

loop.check: Every area, size and outfall id equals a field on the sizing sheet
loop.stop: One pass, then leave a clause blank if the size cell is empty
loop.why_not_simpler: The clause wording differs by control type and a fixed paragraph misses it

steps.what: Draw the drainage layout for that control
Mark clashes on the drainage layout
Sign the drainage design package

tasks.design: Catchment area, soil class and outfall id are fields on a {SPREADSHEET}. The transportation engineer chooses and sizes the drainage control. A {DOCS} specification is filled from those fields, the engineer draws the layout, and signs the package. A machine does not stamp the drawing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Catchment numbers lived in survey mail, so a specification could not show which area it was sized for.
tasks.enabler_now: A survey record can hold catchment id, area, soil class and outfall id for the specification to cite.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing and sizing the control, and drawing it, are still design judgements.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer chooses the control, sizes it and signs. The specification may not invent a size.
tasks.altitude: The specification is no longer retyped from an old project. The sizing and the drawing stay with the engineer.

reach.task: Mark clashes on a drainage layout
reach.learn: Which control type was chosen and which size fields the specification cites

evidence.claim: Drainage and erosion design in a mid-size firm is a sizing sheet plus a layout. The specification repeats those fields. It does not choose the control.
Digest [S4] says a civil-site design product announced generative layout help. That help is design drafting only, and a person still signs. It does not check the sizing calculations.
Digest [S12] and [S13] say safety components in road traffic can be high-risk under the EU AI Act. A model does not choose or size this control. The transportation engineer still signs.
Digest [S20] says a research paper was withdrawn because the institution did not trust the data, so a size in the specification is kept only when it cites the sheet.

assumptions: Focal role is the transportation engineer. The task ends when the signed drainage package is filed. Building the control is later.

Input contract: catchment id, area, soil class, outfall id, control type, size value, unit. Producer of the survey fields is the project survey. The control type and the size are produced by the engineer. A size with no sheet cell is not written into the specification.
Use the document template before custom code. The meeting, the sizing sheet and the drawing stay manual.
The hours prior gives as much time to meetings as to documents. The design meeting stays. The drawing is a system screen, which the prior understates.
unknowns: Which storm the authority requires the sizing to use.
Whether erosion control is a separate package from drainage.
Who signs if a landscape discipline owns the planting.
research_questions: How often does a specification size differ from the sizing sheet?
What share of catchments have no soil class?

already_counted.description: Control choice stays in the design meeting
Sizing time stays with the engineer
Drawing time stays with the engineer

incremental.description: Add a control type to the specification template when a new measure is allowed
Design checker re-marks the layout after a size change

approvals.approved_version: drainage control chosen for this catchment id
drainage package signed for this control type

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes survey fields are blank, so the engineer still types them and still sizes and draws. The high case assumes the fields exist, while the choice, the sizing, the drawing and the signature stay. Construction of the control is not counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Decide if traffic devices or lighting need change

steps.what: Open the device inventory and fault counts
Record device and lighting condition on site
Walk the lighting sample with the inspector
Decide to modify, expand or leave
Draft the need note from that decision

loop.output: need note that cites device ids
loop.check: Every device id and fault count equals an inventory row, and the decision matches the engineer's choice
loop.stop: One pass, then drop a device with no id
loop.why_not_simpler: Why a light should be expanded is not a fixed sentence for a fault count

steps.what: Sign the device-need decision
Place signed needs on the works list

tasks.design: Device id, type, fault count and age sit on a {BI} inventory. The site inspector records a sample of device and lighting condition. The transportation engineer decides modify, expand or leave. A {DOCS} note cites that decision and the counts, and the engineer signs it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Device condition lived in site notebooks, so a later note could not show which device a fault count belonged to.
tasks.enabler_now: An inventory row can hold device id, type, fault count and age, and a sample can cite the same id.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a signal or a light should change is a safety judgement, not a fault threshold.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides modify, expand or leave. A model does not make that call.

ambition.what: Review a device when its fault count crosses a set number, not only on the yearly walk

tasks.altitude: The inventory is no longer rebuilt for each review. The walk sample and the decision stay with people.

reach.task: Sample devices on the list before the decision
reach.learn: Which device ids are in the inventory and which fault counts are already signed

evidence.claim: Deciding whether a traffic device or a light should change is a look at the inventory plus a site sample. The decision is not the fault count itself.

Digest [S12] and [S13] say safety components in road traffic can be high-risk under the EU AI Act. A model does not decide whether a device or a light must change. The transportation engineer still signs.
Digest [S20] says a research paper was withdrawn because the institution did not trust the data, so a fault count in the note is kept only when it cites an inventory row.

assumptions: Focal role is the transportation engineer. The task ends when the signed device decision is placed on the works list. Designing the replacement is later. This is a device and lighting sample, not a corridor-wide system study.

Input contract: device id, device type, fault count, age years, standard clause id, sample result. Producer of the inventory is the operations record. Producer of the sample is the site inspector. The modify, expand or leave choice is produced by the engineer. A count with no device id is dropped.
Use the inventory dashboard before custom code. The walk and the decision stay manual. This design does not watch staff.
The hours prior is heavy on meetings and site time. The walk stays. The inventory read is the part that moves.
unknowns: Which device types are in the inventory.
Whether lighting is owned by another team.
What fault count should trigger a review.
research_questions: What share of devices have no fault count?
How often does the signed decision differ from the inspector's sample note?

already_counted.description: Walk time stays with the engineer
Engineer edits the need note before signing
Signature time stays on the device decision

incremental.description: Add a device type to the inventory filters when a new type is installed
Site inspector repeats a sample the engineer could not read

approvals.approved_version: modify, expand or leave decision for these device ids
device-need note signed for this review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes the inventory has no device ids, so the engineer still compiles the list and still walks. The high case assumes rows exist, while the sample, the decision and the signature stay. Installing a new device is not counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare the project budget, schedule and specifications

steps.what: Submit labour hours, durations and material codes
Accept the rate book for this budget
Price labour hours from the accepted rate book
Lay activities and durations on the schedule
Fill specification clauses from material codes
Confirm material codes they can supply
Sign the budget, schedule and specification
File the signed project pack

tasks.design: Labour hours, activity durations and material codes arrive on a {PROJECT} form. Hours are priced from the accepted rate book on a {SPREADSHEET}. Specification clauses in {DOCS} are filled only for codes on the list. The transportation engineer signs the pack.
tasks.previous_blocker: Budgets, schedules and specifications were three files with different codes, so a material in the specification might be missing from the budget.
tasks.enabler_now: One activity id can carry duration, labour hours and a material code, and the rate book can price the hours.
tasks.still_hard: Accepting the rate book, and agreeing a duration that the contractor disputes, stays a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer accepts the rate book and signs the pack. A clause is not written for a code that is not on the list.

ambition.what: Reissue the signed pack when a duration or a rate changes, not only at the monthly review

tasks.altitude: The engineer stops retyping specification clauses and rate extensions, and still signs each reissue.

reach.task: Track the signed budget and schedule
reach.learn: Which rate-book version was accepted and which material codes are in the specification

evidence.claim: A project budget here is labour hours times a rate book, the schedule is activities and durations, and the specification is clauses for material codes. They are three records, not one essay.
Digest [S20] says a research paper was withdrawn because the institution did not trust the data, so a priced hour is filed only when it cites the rate book and the hour row.

assumptions: Focal role is the transportation engineer. The task ends when the signed budget, schedule and specification pack is filed. This is not the quantity-times-price cost estimate, which uses a bill of quantities.

Input contract: project id, activity id, duration days, labour hours, material code, rate-book id. Producer is the project controller. A specification clause is emitted only for a material code on the submitted list. Hours with no activity id are not priced.
Configure the project schedule and the document template before custom code. The rate-book acceptance stays a human decision.
The hours prior is documents, spreadsheets and screens, with few meetings. These steps follow that and do not add a workshop.
unknowns: Which rate book applies to this contract.
Whether material codes match the contractor's catalogue.
Who may accept a duration the controller disputes.
research_questions: What share of specification clauses have no material code?
How often does a signed duration change before the works start?

already_counted.description: Rate-book acceptance stays with the engineer
Engineer reviews specification clauses against codes
Signature time stays on the pack

incremental.description: Add material codes when the specification library changes
Project controller corrects an activity the schedule rejected

approvals.approved_version: rate book accepted for this project id
budget, schedule and specification signed for this project id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes hours and codes arrive as free text, so the engineer still types them and only the rate extension is new. The high case assumes ids exist, while accepting the rate book and signing the pack stay. Buying the materials is not counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Prices, rates and device counts are looked up, and the engineer keeps the drainage layout and the safety decision.
reach: The project controller receives a signed budget pack when a duration or a rate changes.
The site inspector receives the device list to sample before the engineer decides.
skills_to_grow: Price an estimate as quantity times a named rate, not as a fresh narrative.
Size a drainage control on a sheet before the specification is drafted.
Separate a fault count from the decision to modify a device.
role.ambitious_version: A quantity change reissues a signed estimate, and a device is reviewed when its fault count crosses a set number.
